about.info:
I'm Shabbir Shakir, based in Dubai, UAE. I run Century Fasteners LLC, a fasteners trading company, and alongside the business I design and build web apps, school portals and AI-powered tools.

Before Dubai I spent several years in education, where I produced videos, designs and digital systems for a school, and that is where most of the work in these folders comes from. I studied at Al-Jamea-tus-Saifiyah, and one lesson from there has stayed with me: a person's craft is their treasure.
